newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Chun Tai says to issue 82 mln shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: HK's Chun Tai says to issue 82 mln shares in IPO.

text.p: Consumer electronics manufacturer Chun Tai Holdings Ltd said on Monday it proposed to issue 82 million new shares at HK$1.03 each in an initial public offer (IPO) in Hong Kong.
Chun Tai said the issue price represented a price to earnings multiple of 6.5 times on a fully diluted basis and 5.14 times on a weighted average basis.
The IPO will run from January 21-24, with dealing in the shares expected to begin on February 3. Yuanta Securities is the sponsor and manager of the issue.

The company said the issue would raise about HK$71 million after expenses, with the proceeds used to acquire land-use rights for a new production site in China, buy production equipment and finance research and development.
It would also be used to repay bank loans and as working capital, Chun Tai added.
The company forecast its earnings to be not less than HK$52 million for the year ending on March 31, 1997.
Chun Tai makes video cassette recorders, home appliances, cordless phones and electronic toys.
